verdict.rationale: LiteLLM explicitly ships a self-hosted LLM Gateway/Proxy (docs-5, docs-23) with configurable worker processes and CLI (docs-13/20), and this is corroborated by hands-on community use running it via Docker in a homelab (litellm-comm-6) and widespread adoption as a self-hosted gateway (litellm-comm-7). missing for 10: no independent benchmark or enterprise-scale self-hosting case study beyond a single homelab anecdote.
